exposure: Hours of productive nursing time per delivery
hours of productive nursing time per delivery
outcome: Number of neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) hours per birth
cohort: Low-risk, full gestation births at eleven hospitals in a large, integrated healthcare system in the Southwest
finding: While a simple linear regression showed no statistically significant effect of nursing hours per delivery on the likelihood of a C-section, an 'optimal staffing' model indicated that nurse staffing hours were minimizing C-sections.
mod_finding: The study found that nurse staffing hours were associated with minimizing cesarean section rates.
